scenes.title: 目标总览
scenes.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Re-render Image1 using the USER-APPROVED TWO-LEVEL NAVIGATION in Image2. Image1 is the authority for this screen's main content, task/data values, form/window and state. Replace the old all-in-one sidebar with EXACTLY TWO adjacent left columns: a narrow full-height module rail and a contextual sidebar. Match the approved Image2 proportions and icon/label style consistently across the set. Rail: top返回; then任务/日历/四象限/专注/习惯/纪念日/复盘; bottom通知/设置. Only the specified primary destination is blue-selected. No huge brand block inside the contextual sidebar. White/pale blue-gray surfaces,cobalt accents,thin dividers,crisp readable Chinese,normal controls,not a poster or device mockup.

Preserve Image1's contents and functional meanings, counts,dates,titles,field values,selection,forms,action labels,links and main visual hierarchy except navigation controls specifically moved into the contextual sidebar. Keep a right detail pane ONLY if Image1 contains it. Use the full remaining main width with aligned edges; reflow gently for the two-column shell but do NOT shrink all text, crop content, cover footer buttons or invent fields/types/AI/autosave. Modals must remain complete, on top of a dim backdrop, with their footer actions entirely in the desktop viewport. Keep the same wide canvas, approximately1568x1003.
